svg.title: Ukraine: cyber threaded through the war, not beside it
svg.desc: A diagram of effects for Ukraine's cyber posture in war, drawn as one reinforcing loop with cyber threaded through it and an open strategic edge. All-source sensing raises the targeting and decision picture; the picture raises effect, kinetic and cyber; and effect yields new sensing. The three loop edges run in the same direction, so the loop is reinforcing, marked R and read clockwise. Cyber operations is drawn not as a stage in the loop but as a thread through it, feeding both sensing and effect, by human intervention. A dashed open edge leaves effect toward a decisive strategic outcome and does not close: whether this fusion decides the war is unresolved. And there is no node or edge for a separable cyber war, an absence the loop leaves open, because cyber's contribution runs through the other domains and cannot be isolated. An increase in all-source sensing raises the targeting and decision picture. An increase in the targeting and decision picture raises effect, by human intervention. An increase in effect raises all-source sensing. An increase in cyber operations raises all-source sensing, by human intervention. An increase in cyber operations raises effect, by human intervention.
svg.text: Ukraine: cyber threaded through the war, not beside it
One reinforcing war-cycle, cyber a thread through it rather than a domain beside it, the strategic edge open
One reinforcing loop: all-source sensing feeds the targeting picture, the picture drives effect, kinetic and cyber, and
effect yields new sensing. Cyber is not a stage in the loop but a thread through it, feeding sensing and effect alike.
There is no separable "cyber war" to draw: its contribution runs through the other domains and cannot be isolated.
natural effect, same direction as the movement of the cause
human intervention, same direction as the movement of the cause
the open strategic edge, which does not close: does the fusion decide the war?
